howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Viewflow 库开发 Django 应用，包括创建工作流（BPMN）、增删改查视图、状态机、表单等，并会参考官方文档给出代码建议。
howto.when: 当你提到要使用 Viewflow 库开发 Django 应用，比如涉及工作流、状态机、表单或增删改查视图时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you build Django apps with the Viewflow library, including workflows (BPMN), CRUD viewsets, FSM state transitions, forms, and more, referencing the official documentation for code suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention using the Viewflow library for Django development, such as workflows, state machines, forms, or CRUD viewsets.

say_en.text: Create a leave approval workflow with Viewflow.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Flow subclass and node definitions.

say_en.text: Implement order state transitions using Viewflow FSM.
say_en.note: Claude will provide State and transition code.
